visual_summary: A chaotic ceremonial scene unfolds inside a large ritual chamber or temple filled with robed attendants, machinery, and a crowd. An elderly, grotesque-faced speaker invokes Sama-Wajd and Janus-Jana while a pale, nearly nude figure is dragged or carried toward an altar-like mechanical apparatus. Another armed figure denounces the ceremony. In the central panel the captive is strapped or laid onto the altar amid shouting priests and onlookers, and the page ends with a command to open a glowing tabernacle while a long weapon points toward it.
